tools.name: check_email_domain
tools.description: Classify the domain of an email address or a bare domain as disposable, free (e.g. Gmail), alias (privacy relay), testing, parked or unknown, with the reason, evidence and whether it can receive mail. Use before creating an account or sending a verification email. Unknown means not enough evidence,

tools.name: check_email_domains
tools.description: Classify up to 50 email addresses or domains at once. Results come back in input order; a failed entry has an error and is not charged.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, remaining checks this month and when the allowance resets.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_domain, check_email_domains · Public sink: check_email_domain, check_email_domains.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_domain, check_email_domains · Public sink: check_email_domain, check_email_domains

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
